messages.subject: how to cope with Multiple markers at the same position
parts:
hello,

i have this original rils population genotype data from internet, when i use MQMscan function,
 error was saying "
Multiple markers at the same position
" i checked the data found sure many different markers name have the same CM position ,
what will be the sollution?

best
ma

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how to cope with Multiple markers at the same position
parts:
Use jittermap(), like this:

  mycross <- jittermap(mycross)

karl
